condition: At approximately 1 atm. Sublimation values are not boiling points; ranges represent different isomers or discordant reported normal boiling points, not instrument error.

carbon-dioxide.note: Dry ice sublimes at atmospheric pressure, with no stable liquid phase.

ethyne.note: PubChem HSDB labels -84.7 °C as the sublimation point, not a normal boiling point.

2-butene.note: trans-2-butene ~0.9 °C and cis-2-butene ~3.7 °C. The undifferentiated game molecule cannot be assigned one point.

methyl-ethyl-ether.note: Published values include ~6.6 °C, 7.4 °C, and ~10.1 °C. Excludes the exceptional 312.1 K reading.
